Chapter 19

Gateway APIGateway API

The Gateway API was introduced to standardize and build upon the lessons learned from Ingress and service mesh frameworks like Istio, Contour, and Linkerd, which had demonstrated the need for more sophisticated traffic management capabilities beyond what Ingress could provide. As a more expressive and extensible alternative to the traditional Ingress resource, the Gateway API offers role-oriented design, support for multiple protocols beyond HTTP/HTTPS, and enhanced traffic-routing features.

Gateway API 的引入是为了把 Ingress 以及 Istio、Contour、Linkerd 等服务网格框架所沉淀的经验标准化——这些实践已经表明，业界需要比 Ingress 所能提供的更精细的流量管理能力。作为传统 Ingress 资源的一种表达力更强、可扩展性更好的替代方案，Gateway API 提供了面向角色的设计、对 HTTP/HTTPS 之外多种协议的支持，以及增强的流量路由能力。

The Gateway API is the successor of the Ingress primitive and is becoming increasingly important as organizations adopt this modern approach to managing external traffic.

Gateway API 是 Ingress 原语的继任者；随着越来越多的组织采用这种管理外部流量的现代方式，它正变得日益重要。

As a candidate to the exam, you will need to understand how to deploy the Gateway API and instantiate the relevant objects to stand up Ingress access to your cluster.

作为考生，你需要理解如何部署 Gateway API 并实例化相关对象，从而为你的集群建立 Ingress 访问入口。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Use the Gateway API to manage Ingress traffic.

本章覆盖以下考试大纲目标：使用 Gateway API 管理 Ingress 流量。

Why Is the Ingress Primitive Not Sufficient?为什么 Ingress 原语不够用了？

The Ingress API is the standard Kubernetes way to configure external HTTP/HTTPS load balancing for Services, but it has limitations. While the Ingress supports TLS termination and simple content-based request routing of HTTP traffic, real-world use cases call for more advanced features. Enhancing the existing Ingress API model of the Ingress wouldn’t allow for adding those features easily for a variety of reasons:

Ingress API 是 Kubernetes 为 Service 配置外部 HTTP/HTTPS 负载均衡的标准方式，但它有局限。虽然 Ingress 支持 TLS 终止和简单的、基于内容的 HTTP 请求路由，但真实世界的用例需要更高级的特性。出于多种原因，在现有 Ingress API 模型上做增强无法轻松加入这些特性：

— PDF p.271 —
  • Ingress controller-specific extensibility. Advanced features like traffic splitting, rate limiting, and request/response manipulation are provided by nonportable annotations for specific Ingress implementations.Ingress 控制器特有的可扩展性。流量拆分、限流、请求/响应改写等高级特性，是由面向特定 Ingress 实现的、不可移植的注解提供的。
  • Insufficient permission model. The Ingress API is not well suited for multitenant environments that call for a strong permission model.权限模型不足。Ingress API 不太适合那些需要强权限模型的多租户环境。

In this chapter, I am not going to discuss all possible configuration options and features of the Gateway API. That would go beyond the necessary coverage for the exam. However, I will explain how you can model ingress HTTP traffic similar to what you learned in Chapter 18. See the Gateway API documentation that explains how to implement other use cases.

本章不会讨论 Gateway API 所有可能的配置选项和特性——那会超出考试所需的范围。但我会解释如何像第 18 章所学的那样，对入站 HTTP 流量建模。其他用例的实现方式请参阅 Gateway API 文档。

Working with the Gateway API使用 Gateway API

The Gateway API is the official successor to the Ingress primitive, representing a superset of Ingress functionality, while at the same time enabling more advanced use cases.

Gateway API 是 Ingress 原语的官方继任者，它是 Ingress 功能的超集，同时支持更高级的用例。

You can think of the Gateway API as a unified and standardized API for managing traffic into and out of a Kubernetes cluster instead of having to choose from individual Ingress implementations. Product-specific annotations are not needed anymore to configure routing options. The Gateway API offers a flexible way to incorporate similar features. Effectively, the Gateway API is a universal specification supported by a wide range of different implementations.

你可以把 Gateway API 想象成一个统一、标准化的 API，用于管理进出 Kubernetes 集群的流量，而不必在各个具体的 Ingress 实现之间做选择。配置路由选项时不再需要产品特定的注解；Gateway API 提供了一种灵活的方式来纳入类似的特性。实际上，Gateway API 是一个被众多不同实现所支持的通用规范。

Instead of handling one single primitive like the Ingress, the Gateway API splits up responsibilities into multiple primitives explained in the next section.

Gateway API 不像 Ingress 那样只处理单一原语，而是把职责拆分到多个原语上，下一节会详细介绍。

Gateway API ResourcesGateway API 资源

The Gateway API introduces a layered approach to traffic management through four primary resource types that work together to handle incoming traffic:

Gateway API 通过四种主要资源类型引入了一种分层的流量管理方式，它们协同工作来处理入站流量：

  • Gateway: Defines an instance of traffic-handling infrastructure, such as a cloud load balancer.Gateway：定义一个流量处理基础设施的实例，例如一个云负载均衡器。
  • GatewayClass: Each Gateway is associated with a GatewayClass, which describes the actual kind of gateway controller that will handle traffic for the Gateway.GatewayClass：每个 Gateway 都关联一个 GatewayClass，后者描述将为该 Gateway 处理流量的网关控制器的具体种类。
  • HTTPRoute/GRPCRoute: Defines HTTP- or GRPC-specific rules for mapping traffic from a Gateway listener to a representation of backend network endpoints. These endpoints are often represented as a Service.HTTPRoute/GRPCRoute：定义 HTTP 或 GRPC 专用的规则，用于把来自 Gateway 监听器的流量映射到一组后端网络端点的表示；这些端点通常以 Service 表示。
  • ReferenceGrant: Can be used to enable cross-namespace references within the Gateway API, e.g., routes may forward traffic to backends in other namespaces.ReferenceGrant：可用于在 Gateway API 中启用跨 namespace 引用，例如路由可以把流量转发到其他 namespace 中的后端。

Managing those Gateway API resources falls within the responsibility of different personas, as shown in Figure 19-1.

管理这些 Gateway API 资源属于不同角色的职责，如图 19-1 所示。

— PDF p.272 —

The GatewayClass is provided by platform providers, e.g., the cloud provider. The Gateway and ReferenceGrant are installed by the Kubernetes cluster administrator. Lastly, the HTTPRoute and GRPCRoute are created by application developers.

GatewayClass 由平台提供方（例如云厂商）提供；Gateway 和 ReferenceGrant 由 Kubernetes 集群管理员安装；而 HTTPRoute 和 GRPCRoute 则由应用开发者创建。

The prominent Gateway API use case I want to demonstrate in this chapter is how to route HTTP ingress traffic to multiple Services based on a context URL. Figure 19-2 illustrates this use case.

本章我想演示的一个典型 Gateway API 用例是：如何基于上下文 URL 把 HTTP 入站流量路由到多个 Service。图 19-2 描绘了这个用例。

— PDF p.273 —

Before we can actually create the objects shown in the visualization, we’ll need to tell the Kubernetes cluster about the Gateway API CRDs.

在真正创建图中所示对象之前，我们需要先让 Kubernetes 集群认识 Gateway API 的 CRD。

Installing the Gateway API CRDs安装 Gateway API CRD

At the time of writing, the Gateway API resources do not ship with the standard set of Kubernetes API resources. You will have to install the Gateway API in the form of Custom Resource Definitions. The following command installs version 1.3.0 of the CRDs:

在撰写本书时，Gateway API 资源并不随 Kubernetes 标准 API 资源集一起发布。你需要以 Custom Resource Definition（CRD）的形式安装 Gateway API。下面的命令安装 1.3.0 版本的 CRD：

$ kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/\
download/v1.3.0/standard-install.yaml
customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/\
gatewayclasses.gateway.networking.k8s.io created
customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/\
gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io created
customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/\
grpcroutes.gateway.networking.k8s.io created
customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/\
httproutes.gateway.networking.k8s.io created
customresourcedefinition.apiextensions.k8s.io/\
referencegrants.gateway.networking.k8s.io created

You will now be able to list the CRDs by searching for the API group used by the Gateway API resources:

现在你可以通过搜索 Gateway API 资源所使用的 API 组来列出这些 CRD：

$ kubectl get crds | grep gateway.networking.k8s.io
gatewayclasses.gateway.networking.k8s.io    2025-08-07T18:14:16Z
gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io          2025-08-07T18:14:16Z
grpcroutes.gateway.networking.k8s.io        2025-08-07T18:14:16Z
httproutes.gateway.networking.k8s.io        2025-08-07T18:14:16Z
referencegrants.gateway.networking.k8s.io   2025-08-07T18:14:17Z

See the official GitHub repository for more information on the Gateway API.

关于 Gateway API 的更多信息，请参阅官方 GitHub 仓库。

Deploying a Gateway Controller部署 Gateway 控制器

The Gateway API requires a controller implementation to function. Different controllers offer various features and performance characteristics. For this example, we’ll use the Envoy Gateway implementation installed by Helm:

Gateway API 需要一个控制器实现才能工作。不同控制器提供不同的特性和性能表现。本示例中，我们使用由 Helm 安装的 Envoy Gateway 实现：

— PDF p.274 —
$ helm install eg oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm --version v1.4.2 \
  -n envoy-gateway-system --create-namespace

You will want to wait until the Gateway implementation becomes fully functional:

你需要等到 Gateway 实现完全可用：

$ kubectl wait --timeout=5m -n envoy-gateway-system deployment/envoy-gateway \
  --for=condition=Available
deployment.apps/envoy-gateway condition met

With the prerequisites in place, we’ll set up everything needed to use the Gateway API to route Ingress HTTP traffic to a Service backend.

前置条件就绪后，我们将搭建使用 Gateway API 把入站 HTTP 流量路由到 Service 后端所需的一切。

Creating GatewayClasses创建 GatewayClass

Depending on the Kubernetes environment you are operating in, you may or may not have to create a GatewayClass. Cloud provider Kubernetes clusters should already come with one.

根据你所操作的 Kubernetes 环境不同，你可能需要、也可能不需要创建 GatewayClass。云厂商的 Kubernetes 集群通常已经自带一个。

In case you want to create your own GatewayClass, you will first have to determine the Gateway controller name. The controller name depends on the controller implementation installed. You can usually look up the controller name in its documentation.

如果你想创建自己的 GatewayClass，首先需要确定 Gateway 控制器名称。控制器名称取决于所安装的控制器实现，通常可以在其文档中查到。

The controller name for Envoy is gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller. Create the file gateway-class.yaml with the contents shown in Example 19-1.

Envoy 的控制器名称是 gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller。创建文件 gateway-class.yaml，内容如示例 19-1 所示。

Example 19-1. A GatewayClass that uses the Envoy GatewayClass controller

示例 19-1. 使用 Envoy GatewayClass 控制器的 GatewayClass

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: GatewayClass
metadata:
  name: envoy
spec:
  controllerName: gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller

The reference to the controller installed by the Helm chart

对由 Helm chart 安装的控制器的引用

Run the following command to create the GatewayClass object:

运行以下命令创建 GatewayClass 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f gateway-class.yaml
gatewayclass.gateway.networking.k8s.io/envoy created

To list GatewayClass objects, run the following command:

要列出 GatewayClass 对象，运行以下命令：

$ kubectl get gatewayclasses
NAME    CONTROLLER                                      ACCEPTED   AGE
envoy   gateway.envoyproxy.io/gatewayclass-controller   True       31s

You should see the object we created earlier, and potentially other GatewayClass objects that came with the Kubernetes environment.

你应该能看到我们之前创建的对象，以及可能由 Kubernetes 环境自带的其他 GatewayClass 对象。

— PDF p.275 —

Creating Gateways创建 Gateway

With the GatewayClass instantiated, create a Gateway resource to handle incoming traffic. Create a YAML manifest file named gateway.yaml and populate the content, as shown in Example 19-2.

GatewayClass 实例化之后，创建一个 Gateway 资源来处理入站流量。创建名为 gateway.yaml 的 YAML manifest 文件，内容如示例 19-2 所示。

Example 19-2. A Gateway exposing an HTTP listener

示例 19-2. 暴露一个 HTTP 监听器的 Gateway

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: hello-world-gateway
spec:
  gatewayClassName: envoy
  listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 80
  • References the GatewayClass by name按名称引用 GatewayClass
  • The listener accepting HTTP traffic on port 80在 80 端口接收 HTTP 流量的监听器

Run the following command to create the Gateway object:

运行以下命令创建 Gateway 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f gateway.yaml
gateway.gateway.networking.k8s.io/hello-world-gateway created

You list the Gateway object with the following command:

用以下命令列出 Gateway 对象：

$ kubectl get gateways
NAME                  CLASS   ADDRESS   PROGRAMMED   AGE
hello-world-gateway   envoy             False        16s

There’s only one additional object to set up to finalize the HTTP traffic routing: the HTTPRoute object.

要完成 HTTP 流量路由，只剩一个额外对象需要设置：HTTPRoute 对象。

Creating HTTPRoutes创建 HTTPRoute

Store the definition of the HTTPRoute in the YAML manifest file named httproute.yaml, shown in Example 19-3. For brevity, this chapter will not demonstrate how to create Service backends. Please reference Chapter 17 for more information.

把 HTTPRoute 的定义存放在名为 httproute.yaml 的 YAML manifest 文件中，如示例 19-3 所示。为简洁起见，本章不演示如何创建 Service 后端；更多信息请参阅第 17 章。

Example 19-3. An HTTPRoute routing traffic to a Service backend

示例 19-3. 把流量路由到 Service 后端的 HTTPRoute

apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: hello-world-httproute
— PDF p.276 —
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: hello-world-gateway
  hostnames:
    - "hello-world.exposed"
  rules:
    - backendRefs:
        - group: ""
          kind: Service
          name: web
          port: 3000
          weight: 1
      matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /
  • The hostname to make traffic routing available for用于启用流量路由的主机名
  • The Service backend to route the traffic to把流量路由到的 Service 后端
  • Determines the proportion of traffic that will be sent to that specific Service决定将发送到该特定 Service 的流量比例
  • The routing rules based on the requested URL context基于所请求 URL 上下文的路由规则

Run the following command to create the HTTPRoute object:

运行以下命令创建 HTTPRoute 对象：

$ kubectl apply -f httproute.yaml
httproute.gateway.networking.k8s.io/hello-world-httproute created

You can list all HTTPRoute objects with the command shown:

你可以用下面的命令列出所有 HTTPRoute 对象：

$ kubectl get httproutes
NAME                    HOSTNAMES                 AGE
hello-world-httproute   ["hello-world.exposed"]   64s

Accessing the Gateway访问 Gateway

Accessing the Gateway differs depending on the Kubernetes cluster you are using. Follow the instructions in the section based on your Kubernetes cluster setup, and assume that you don’t have external load balancer support.

访问 Gateway 的方式因你所使用的 Kubernetes 集群而异。请根据你的 Kubernetes 集群环境阅读相应小节的说明，并假设你没有外部负载均衡器支持。

Get the name of the Envoy Service created by the example Gateway, and assign it to the environment variable ENVOY_SERVICE:

获取示例 Gateway 所创建的 Envoy Service 的名称，并把它赋给环境变量 ENVOY_SERVICE：

$ export ENVOY_SERVICE=$(kubectl get svc -n envoy-gateway-system \
  --selector=gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-namespace=default,\
  gateway.envoyproxy.io/owning-gateway-name=hello-world-gateway \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')

Port forward to the Envoy Service:

把端口转发到 Envoy Service：

— PDF p.277 —
$ kubectl -n envoy-gateway-system port-forward service/${ENVOY_SERVICE} 8889:80 &
[2] 93490
Forwarding from 127.0.0.1:8889 -> 10080
Forwarding from [::1]:8889 -> 10080

With the relevant entry in /etc/hosts, you should be able to make a call to the Gateway:

在 /etc/hosts 中配置好相应条目后，你应该就能对 Gateway 发起调用了：

$ curl hello-world.exposed:8889
Handling connection for 8889
Hello World

In this example, the backend returns with the message “Hello World.” A successful response may look different depending on the implementation details of your application.

在本例中，后端返回消息“Hello World.”。成功的响应可能因你应用的实现细节而异。

Ingress to Gateway API Migration从 Ingress 迁移到 Gateway API

The Gateway API represents the next evolution of traffic management in Kubernetes, designed to eventually replace the traditional Ingress resource.

Gateway API 代表 Kubernetes 流量管理的下一次演进，其设计目标是最终取代传统的 Ingress 资源。

The transition typically involves replacing Ingress resources with Gateway and HTTPRoute combinations. A single Gateway resource can handle multiple applications through different Route resources, similar to how an Ingress Controller works but with cleaner separation of responsibilities.

这种过渡通常涉及用 Gateway 与 HTTPRoute 的组合替换 Ingress 资源。一个 Gateway 资源可以通过不同的 Route 资源处理多个应用，工作方式类似 Ingress 控制器，但职责分离更清晰。

The Gateway API graduated to stable status for core features in late 2023. While Ingress remains supported and widely used, major ingress controllers like NGINX, Istio, and Envoy Gateway now offer Gateway API implementations. Organizations should evaluate migration based on their need for advanced traffic management features and operational complexity requirements.

Gateway API 的核心特性已于 2023 年底晋升为 stable 状态。虽然 Ingress 仍受支持且被广泛使用，但 NGINX、Istio、Envoy Gateway 等主流 Ingress 控制器现在都提供了 Gateway API 实现。组织应根据自身对高级流量管理特性的需求以及运维复杂度要求，评估是否迁移。

Most migrations follow a phased approach: deploying Gateway API alongside existing Ingress, gradually migrating applications, and eventually deprecating Ingress resources. Many controllers support both APIs simultaneously, allowing for smooth transitions without service disruption.

大多数迁移采用分阶段方式：先在现有 Ingress 旁边部署 Gateway API，逐步迁移应用，最终弃用 Ingress 资源。许多控制器同时支持两种 API，从而可以平滑过渡而不中断服务。

The official conversion tool named ingress2gateway automatically translates Ingress resources to Gateway API equivalents. It handles basic conversions and provides a foundation for more complex migrations. I am only mentioning this tool for completeness’ sake. You are not expected to understand or use it in the exam.

官方转换工具名为 ingress2gateway，能自动把 Ingress 资源翻译为等价的 Gateway API。它处理基本转换，并为更复杂的迁移提供基础。提及该工具只是为了完整性；考试不要求你理解或使用它。

— PDF p.278 —

Summary本章小结

The Gateway API represents the future of Kubernetes ingress management, offering powerful features while maintaining clarity through its role-oriented design. As more organizations adopt this standard, proficiency with the Gateway API becomes an essential skill for Kubernetes administrators.

Gateway API 代表 Kubernetes Ingress 管理的未来：它提供强大的特性，同时通过面向角色的设计保持清晰。随着越来越多组织采用这一标准，熟练掌握 Gateway API 将成为 Kubernetes 管理员的必备技能。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Check on existing GatewayClasses. Remember that the exam environment may have preinstalled Gateway controllers, so always check available GatewayClasses before creating resources.查看已有的 GatewayClass。请记住考试环境可能已预装 Gateway 控制器，因此在创建资源前一定要先查看可用的 GatewayClass。
  • Understand the Gateway API CRDs. Practice creating different Gateway configurations, experiment with various HTTPRoute patterns, and understand how the components work together to build a solid foundation for managing production traffic.理解 Gateway API CRD。练习创建不同的 Gateway 配置，尝试各种 HTTPRoute 模式，并理解各组件如何协同工作，为管理生产流量打下坚实基础。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的解答见附录 A。

  1. You are tasked with setting up ingress traffic management for a new application using the Gateway API. The application consists of two services that need to be accessible from outside the cluster. Use the NGINX Gateway Fabric controller implementation. Create a Deployment named web-app with two replicas using the nginx:1.21 image in the default namespace. Create a Deployment named api-app with two replicas using the httpd:2.4 image in the default namespace. Expose both Deployments as ClusterIP Services on port 80. You can shortcut the setup by applying the YAML file setup.yaml in the directory app-a/ch19/basic-gateway of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create a Gateway named main-gateway in the default namespace. Configure it to listen on port 80 for HTTP traffic. Use the hostname example.local. Create an HTTPRoute named app-routes that routes traffic with path /web to the web-app Service. It also routes traffic with path /api to the api-app Service. Define path prefix matching. Check that the Gateway is ready and has an assigned IP/hostname. Verify that the HTTPRoute is accepted and bound to the Gateway, then test connectivity to the Gateway.你的任务是为一个新应用使用 Gateway API 搭建入站流量管理。该应用由两个需要从集群外部访问的服务组成。使用 NGINX Gateway Fabric 控制器实现。在 default namespace 中创建名为 web-app 的 Deployment，两个副本，使用 nginx:1.21 镜像；创建名为 api-app 的 Deployment，两个副本，使用 httpd:2.4 镜像。把两个 Deployment 都暴露为端口 80 的 ClusterIP Service。你可以在已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中，通过应用 app-a/ch19/basic-gateway 目录下的 setup.yaml 来快速完成搭建。在 default namespace 中创建名为 main-gateway 的 Gateway，配置它在 80 端口监听 HTTP 流量，主机名使用 example.local。创建名为 app-routes 的 HTTPRoute，把路径 /web 的流量路由到 web-app Service，把路径 /api 的流量路由到 api-app Service，使用路径前缀匹配。检查 Gateway 是否就绪并已分配 IP/主机名。验证 HTTPRoute 已被接受并绑定到 Gateway，然后测试到 Gateway 的连通性。
— PDF p.279 —
  1. Your organization needs to set up a production-ready Gateway configuration that handles HTTP traffic for applications across multiple namespaces. Use the NGINX Gateway Fabric controller implementation. Create two namespaces named production and staging. In the production namespace, create a Deployment named prod-web with three replicas using the nginx:1.22 image. Create a ClusterIP Service exposing port 80, which routes traffic to the replicas of prod-web. In the staging namespace, create a Deployment named staging-web with two replicas using the nginx:1.21 image. Create a ClusterIP Service exposing port 80, which routes traffic to the replicas of staging-web. You can shortcut the setup by applying the YAML file setup.yaml in the directory app-a/ch19/cross-namespace-gateway of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Create a Gateway named gateway in the production namespace. Configure an HTTP listener on port 80. Use the hostname example.com. Create an HTTPRoute named prod-route in the production namespace. The object should route traffic with path /app to the prod-web Service, use exact path matching, and attach to the gateway. Create another HTTPRoute named staging-route in the staging namespace. The object should route traffic with path /staging to the staging-web Service, use path prefix matching, and attach to the gateway in the production namespace. Configure proper cross-namespace reference policy. Add request headers to identify the environment (production versus staging). Verify the correct HTTP routing. The production route should only respond to the exact path /app. The staging route should respond to /staging. Both routes should successfully serve the NGINX welcome page.你的组织需要搭建一份生产级的 Gateway 配置，用于跨多个 namespace 处理应用的 HTTP 流量。使用 NGINX Gateway Fabric 控制器实现。创建两个名为 production 和 staging 的 namespace。在 production namespace 中创建名为 prod-web 的 Deployment，三个副本，使用 nginx:1.22 镜像；创建一个暴露 80 端口的 ClusterIP Service，把流量路由到 prod-web 的副本。在 staging namespace 中创建名为 staging-web 的 Deployment，两个副本，使用 nginx:1.21 镜像；创建一个暴露 80 端口的 ClusterIP Service，把流量路由到 staging-web 的副本。你可以在已 checkout 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 中，通过应用 app-a/ch19/cross-namespace-gateway 目录下的 setup.yaml 来快速完成搭建。在 production namespace 中创建名为 gateway 的 Gateway，配置 80 端口的 HTTP 监听器，主机名使用 example.com。在 production namespace 中创建名为 prod-route 的 HTTPRoute，把路径 /app 的流量路由到 prod-web Service，使用精确路径匹配，并绑定到该 gateway。在 staging namespace 中再创建名为 staging-route 的 HTTPRoute，把路径 /staging 的流量路由到 staging-web Service，使用路径前缀匹配，并绑定到 production namespace 中的那个 gateway。配置正确的跨 namespace 引用策略。添加请求头以标识环境（production 与 staging）。验证 HTTP 路由正确：production 路由只应对精确路径 /app 响应，staging 路由应对 /staging 响应，两条路由都应能成功返回 NGINX 欢迎页。
